Every Spotify play of 30 seconds or more counts, for any song, charted on Willboard or not. "This week" is the last 7 days; "this month" and "this year" run from the 1st through the latest plays. Movement compares with the same number of days just before. NEW means the first play falls in these dates; RE means it's back in the top after time away. Single, album and remix versions of a song add up. Artists are credited by the lead artist Spotify lists. Days are Mountain time.
